1. (Currently amended) A method comprising:
receiving requests and data records from a plurality of creditors to file bankruptcy documents with a plurality of different bankruptcy organizations, wherein the bankruptcy documents include proofs of claim forms and supporting documentation specific to each creditor's debt;
automatically generating the bankruptcy documents with the received data records by validating the data records and formatting them according to the requirements of each bankruptcy organization, wherein the bankruptcy documents are suitable for filing with different bankruptcy organizations; and
batch filing the bankruptcy documents with the different bankruptcy organizations at least once per day in aggregated form.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the different bankruptcy organizations are different courts with different filing system configurations, and wherein the method further comprises automatically adapting the bankruptcy documents to comply with each court's specific filing requirements and system configurations.

6. (Currently amended) A method comprising:
receiving requests from a plurality of creditors to file proofs of claims for debts owed by debtors to the creditors with a plurality of different bankruptcy organizations, wherein each request includes a data record for generating a proof of claim, and wherein the data records are validated prior to generating the proofs of claims;
automatically generating the proofs of claims with the received data records by formatting each proof of claim according to the specific requirements of the target bankruptcy organization, wherein the proofs of claims are suitable for filing with different bankruptcy organizations; and
batch filing the proofs of claims with the different bankruptcy organizations in aggregated batches at least once per day.

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 wherein the different bankruptcy organizations are different bankruptcy courts having different filing system configurations, and wherein the proofs of claims are automatically formatted to comply with each court's specific filing system requirements.

8. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 further comprising sending bankruptcy notification messages to the plurality of creditors via email or website notification, wherein the bankruptcy notification messages notify the creditors that various debtors have filed for bankruptcy and provide status updates on filed proofs of claims.

9. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 wherein receiving requests from the plurality of creditors comprises receiving the requests using a secure file transfer protocol with encryption technology.

10. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 wherein receiving requests comprises receiving requests via a Web site with secure authentication.

11. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 where batch filing comprises aggregating the proofs of claims and filing the proofs of claims in a batch mode at least once per day, wherein the aggregation includes organizing proofs of claims by target bankruptcy organization.

12. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 further comprising:
generating a report specific to a particular creditor that includes status information on proofs of claims filed on behalf of that creditor; and
sending the report to the particular creditor via email or website access.

13. (Currently amended) The method of claim 12 wherein generating the report comprises enabling a user to request the report using a Web site with secure creditor authentication.

14. (Currently amended) The method of claim 12 wherein generating the report comprises generating an aging report specifying a reason some proofs of claims have not been filed, including validation errors or pending court processing.

15. (Currently amended) The method of claim 12 further comprising receiving a filing receipt for a filed proof of claim and providing the filing receipt to the creditor.

16. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 wherein batch filing is performed by a server computer that aggregates and formats proofs of claims for multiple creditors and multiple bankruptcy organizations.

17. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 further comprising validating the data record to ensure compliance with the requirements of the target bankruptcy organization prior to generating the proof of claim.
